note_tweet.text:
This Week in Replit

1) The Self-Driving Company. We believe by the end of 2030, every Fortune 500 will be a Self-Driving Company. That doesn't mean AI replaces people. People remain in the driver's seat leading judgment, creativity and taste, while agents fuel execution.

→ https://t.co/KgG56AZyMp

2) Anyone can now bring their ideas into the company codebase. Replit Cloud Agents turn natural language into a tested pull request, and engineers still approve the final code before it ships. Our own design team used Replit to safely ship over 250k lines of code in the last 6 months. Now available for Pro and Enterprise users.

→ Connect a repo: https://t.co/7fNJlz4fQo

3) Security has to scale with agent autonomy. Our existing isolation protections prevented exploitation of last week's disclosed kernel vulnerabilities, and we patched affected tooling centrally, reducing remediation work for developers. Our CTO Luis Héctor Chávez (@lhchavez) explains what's available today and what's next.

→ https://t.co/6BEySdjGNK

4) ViBench 2.0, a benchmark for long-horizon software building. Agents start from an empty project and build a whole product, one feature at a time, without seeing what comes next. Even the best models pass every check in only 49-65% of builds. Now part of Fireworks AI's Specialized Intelligence Index.

→ https://t.co/k9ucnlN7uz

5) GPT-6.1 Terra is now available in Power Mode.

6) Replit is now fully available in Japanese.

Full replay of today's show, with Clarisse Chan (FP&A Lead) on how Replit's finance team builds its own tools on Replit: https://t.co/Et6ckKLqgS

This Week in Replit

1) Stripe Atlas on Replit. Ask Replit to incorporate your business through the Stripe MCP integration, with 20% off when you incorporate through Replit.

→ Try it today. Ask Replit: "Incorporate my business with Stripe Atlas"

2) Chat and asset sharing. Give your teammate the full context rather than just the summary. Share a whole chat or a single asset with selected teammates or your whole workspace. No copy-pasting the whole chat.

→ Hit Share at the top of your chat: https://t.co/kBSSIupDTL

3) Create and update skills. Turn useful workflows from your conversations and projects into reusable workspace skills. Replit suggests new skills or improvements to existing ones, and you approve them before they're saved.

→ Nailed a workflow? Ask Replit: "Turn this into a skill"

4) Meet Replit for Government. National, state, local, tribal, and territorial governments can now turn shared knowledge into useful tools. Because public service deserves better software.

→ https://t.co/vkVJLLxWV5

5) Security update. Recent vulnerabilities in widely used third-party software created risks across the internet. Replit patched infrastructure, updated language tooling, and blocked exploits to protect your apps. Where you need to republish, you'll get clear instructions.

→ https://t.co/r8QQJatd5c

6) Meet Replit Monitoring Agent, your autonomous on-call engineer. It can see, fix, and deploy changes autonomously. Turn on Monitoring alerts and Auto-fix, and add Auto-republish to ship validated fixes on their own.

→ https://t.co/vEoUEWQjbW

Full replay of today's sh, with Jon Cheney on building a $20M company on Replit, and Andrea Leang and Josh McFarlin on Monitoring Agent: https://t.co/X7syUfneGh
